revisions.name: host-file
revisions.reason: Review 20261125 CLI harness overhead: thread-manager gains synchronous local-owner twins noteMainSleepLocal/checkMainMessageWaitLocal (same owner calls in the same order as the async versions, used only by test/run.js's local-owner batch fast path); host-audio exposes waveCallbacksIdle(), a read-only predicate over the wave/MIDI callback queues, and host-imports forwards it on ctx. No EIP write, callback frame, guest stack, HWND lifetime or message delivery changed; callback ownership remains pending.
